name: Gakin's Summons
summary: In Stormwind, Gakin's Summons draws promising warlocks beneath the Slaughtered Lamb. Remen Marcot brings Gakin the Darkbinder's message, sending fledgling practitioners to the crypts under the tavern in the Mage Quarter for further occult training.

sections.title: A Discrete Message
sections.body: Demonology is forbidden in Stormwind's settled districts, yet its practitioners work near the city guard. When a warlock shows skill with introductory imps, word reaches senior warlocks in secret. Remen Marcot carries their message quietly and urges new practitioners to keep the meeting place private as they make their way beneath the Mage Quarter.

sections.title: The Crypts of the Slaughtered Lamb
sections.body: Cellars and hidden catacombs lie behind the Slaughtered Lamb's modest front. Gakin the Darkbinder teaches Stormwind's warlocks there, beyond the reach of Kirin Tor mages and the Cathedral's inquisitors. Under his guidance, warlocks learn to command a voidwalker. The rite demands dangerous stolen reagents and perilous summoning circles.

faq.q: Why does Gakin the Darkbinder summon warlocks?
faq.answer: Gakin summons budding warlocks once they have gained enough experience. He sees the untrained as a danger, liable to lose their heads, and teaches them the complex ritual for binding a voidwalker to their service.

faq.q: Where is Gakin the Darkbinder located?
faq.answer: Gakin is hidden in deep crypts beneath the Slaughtered Lamb, a tavern in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

Remen Marcot is an associate of Stormwind's warlock coven. He stays in the cellar of the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, seeking promising candidates and quietly guiding them to Gakin's hidden enclave.

faq.q: Why must the location be kept secret?
faq.answer: Fel magic and demon summoning are forbidden in the Kingdom of Stormwind. The Silver Hand, the Cathedral of Light, or the city guards could discover the coven, bringing imprisonment or execution.

faq.q: What comes after answering Gakin's summons?
faq.answer: After you report to Gakin, he sends you to the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in Elwynn Forest. There, you are to recover a bloodstone choker from Surena Caledon, essential to the voidwalker binding ritual.
No. Only warlocks who have mastered their basic imp companion receive the summons and advanced occult instruction.

angles.text: As a warlock, you are moving beyond parlor tricks and minor imps. The trials ahead prepare you to enslave a voidwalker to shield you in battle.
As an Alliance member, you know Stormwind tolerates a hidden cabal of shadow-weavers. Their fel expertise gives the Alliance an edge against its enemies.
